summary: Master HSE Leadership for Oil and Gas. Align with IOGP standards and ISO 45001 to drive safety culture and mitigate process risks. Enroll for expert training.
lede: HSE leadership in oil and gas helps managers and specialists responsible for safety manage operational risks. The course develops practical skills in incident investigation and root cause analysis, process safety and asset integrity, contractor oversight, and risk assessment using BowTie modeling. It also covers safety culture, fatigue management, emergency response, environmental management, and reporting safety performance to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals responsible for safety outcomes in upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.
modules: Safety Leadership Foundations and IOGP Standards
Process Safety Management and Asset Integrity
Advanced Risk Assessment and BowTie Modeling
Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis
Contractor Safety and Supply Chain Management
Digital Transformation and AI in Safety
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in an operational or supervisory role within the oil and gas industry. Familiarity with basic health and safety concepts is required. Prior exposure to ISO 45001 or IOGP standards is beneficial but not mandatory.
